name: Quantt
description: Interactive courses in quant finance, maths and tech. Every lesson is code you write and tests you pass, e.g. a momentum backtest with a kill-switch on drawdown (company-stated). Meta description: "60+ interactive courses" covering Python for finance, derivatives pricing, portfolio theory, risk management (company-stated). Pricing: £39.95/month, £249.95/year, enterprise custom, 30-day money-back (founder-stated). Target: CS grads, career changers, juniors breaking into quant (founder-stated). Founded Dec 2025, UK. 154 active subscriptions.
